citation: Microbiome Repo, release R2026.43 (data package 1.34.2), Olm Lab, University of Colorado Boulder, 2026-11-24. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23087712
description: Evidence-linked metadata for public human microbiome sequencing data — shotgun metagenomes and metatranscriptomes from every body site, all ages. A project = an INSDC BioProject; a sample = a BioSample (rarely a run).
how_to_search: Pick the most specific selection: api/by-intervention/<code>.json, api/by-condition/<code>.json or api/by-age/<category>.json (codes in api/vocabularies.json).
Filter its projects on the other keys (health_conditions counts, interventions, intervention_design, has_cases_and_healthy_controls, has_treated_and_control_arms, n_samples, countries).
For each candidate open urls.samples_csv to see the samples, their arms (intervention column), conditions and sequencing depth (seq_gbp).
Cite the project page (urls.page) and the ENA accession; values carry evidence on the project page.
The code "unknown" in api/vocabularies.json means the value is not known for a sample; no file is written for it.
licence: Curated values CC-BY-4.0; archive metadata under INSDC terms; Sandpiper community profiles CC-BY.
name: Microbiome Repo

project_keys.has_cases_and_healthy_controls: >= 3 healthy_control samples and >= 3 samples with a disease code
project_keys.has_treated_and_control_arms: >= 3 samples in an active arm and >= 3 placebo / no_intervention samples (archive attributes)
project_keys.intervention_design: randomized_controlled_trial | non_randomized_controlled | crossover | single_arm_before_after | observational_with_procedure | none | unknown
project_keys.intervention_detail: short free text naming agent / regimen
project_keys.interventions: interventions the project ADMINISTERED (project level, from abstract / description; [] = none stated)
project_keys.sample_intervention_arms: code -> number of samples whose own archive record states the arm (placebo / no_intervention = controls / baselines)
project_keys.title: project title
project_keys.trial_population_condition: underlying condition of the trial population
project_keys.urls: page, samples_csv (plain CSV), samples_full_csv_gz, evidence_csv_gz, ena

sample_columns.age_at_collection_days: age of the person at collection, in days
sample_columns.age_category: life stage of the person at collection: neonate, infant, child, adolescent, adult, elderly (empty when not known)
sample_columns.antibiotic_exposure: yes / no: whether a source documents antibiotics before or at sampling ('no' needs a source that documents no exposure)
sample_columns.body_site_class: whether a body site is stated for this sample ('primary') or not ('unknown')
sample_columns.collection_date: date of collection, as specific as the source gives it (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or an interval)
sample_columns.country: ISO-2 code of the country the sample was collected or the person recruited in (not the laboratory)
sample_columns.health_condition: condition of this sample, as a code (codes and labels in api/vocabularies.json)
sample_columns.health_condition_detail: free text behind the code: diagnosis, group label or criterion
sample_columns.intervention: the arm recorded for this sample; 'placebo' and 'no_intervention' are the controls and baselines
sample_columns.intervention_detail: short free text naming the agent or regimen
sample_columns.n_runs: number of sequencing runs of this sample
sample_columns.sample_key: identifier of the sample in this resource: its BioSample accession, or the run accession where the project is keyed by run
sample_columns.seq_gbp: sequenced bases of this sample, in gigabases
sample_columns.sex: sex as stated by the source
sample_columns.study_accession: BioProject accession of the project the sample belongs to
sample_columns.subject_id: the submitter's identifier of the person sampled (never a sample id)
sample_columns.timepoint_label: the source's own label for the timepoint (D6, M4, baseline); it is a label, not an age
